component: Thunderbird leak-detection document and selected harness controls

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The leak guide points to a 50 kB threshold and a detached-window test. The checked comm configuration sets 51200-byte options for two named Thunderbird browser/a11y command lists; this is not every harness's threshold. The selected compose scenario closes its window and clears references before a helper gathers memory-reporter window paths and reports detached entries. This links documentation to concrete configured/test controls without proving leak-free execution, native reporter behavior or all-window coverage.
title: The leak guide's threshold and detached-window examples have distinct source scopes
